mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) reflects a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is above its 10-year average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals an accelerating labor market deterioration, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month moving average signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during recessions when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy that is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals weak consumer demand for housing, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate a severe economic contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 305), rising consumer prices signal the Federal Reserve's potential for aggressive rate hikes, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 305), or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year window.
